name: sgs/wishlist-link
title: SGS Wishlist Link
description: A header/footer wishlist icon-link with a live saved-item count badge. Links to the wishlist panel (or a custom URL).

showLabel.description: Desktop tier: show the visible text label next to the icon (the label stays the accessible name via aria-label on the link when hidden). Default false (icon-only). Framework flat tier convention (BooleanResponsiveControl) — Desktop is always a concrete boolean, Tablet/Mobile override via the two sibling attrs below (null = inherit the tier above).

showLabelTablet.description: Tablet override for showLabel. null = inherit Desktop. 'string' is in the type union only because @wordpress/server-side-render's GET transport serialises a null value to an empty string in the REST query string (see sgs/before-after videoAutoplayTablet) — render.php treats '' identically to null.

showLabelMobile.description: Mobile override for showLabel. null = inherit the resolved Tablet value. Same REST-shim 'string' union as showLabelTablet.
